```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 4.5,
  dpi = 120,
  fig.align = "center"
)
results <- params$results
summary_tbl <- params$summary_tbl
sensitivity_tbl <- params$sensitivity_tbl
surv_res <- params$surv_res
beyond_inf <- params$beyond_inf
pl <- params$params_list
if (is.null(pl)) pl <- list()

model <- params$report_model
if (is.null(model) && is.data.frame(results)) {
  model <- SigBenchR::build_report_model(
    results = results,
    summary_tbl = if (is.data.frame(summary_tbl) && nrow(summary_tbl) > 0L) summary_tbl else NULL,
    sensitivity_tbl = sensitivity_tbl,
    params_list = pl,
    ref_axes = if (!is.null(pl$bio_context) && is.data.frame(pl$bio_context)) pl$bio_context else NULL,
    surv_res = surv_res,
    beyond_inf = beyond_inf
  )
}

hm <- if (!is.null(model$tier1$active_method)) {
  model$tier1$active_method
} else if (!is.null(pl$heatmap_method)) {
  as.character(pl$heatmap_method)[1]
} else {
  "mean"
}
fsig <- if (!is.null(pl$forest_signature)) as.character(pl$forest_signature)[1] else NA_character_
cov_thr <- if (!is.null(pl$coverage_threshold)) as.numeric(pl$coverage_threshold)[1] else 0.70
compute_null <- isTRUE(pl$compute_null)
if (!compute_null && is.data.frame(results) && "null_p" %in% names(results)) {
  compute_null <- any(is.finite(results$null_p), na.rm = TRUE)
}

.em <- "\u2014"
.en <- "\u2013"

.fmt3 <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(is.finite(x), sprintf("%.3f", x), .em)
}

.fmt_pct <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(is.finite(x), sprintf("%.1f%%", x), .em)
}

.fmt_p <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  out <- rep(.em, length(x))
  ok <- is.finite(x)
  out[ok & x < 0.001] <- "<0.001"
  out[ok & x >= 0.001] <- sprintf("%.3f", x[ok & x >= 0.001])
  out
}

.fmt_null <- function(x) {
  if (!isTRUE(compute_null)) {
    return(rep("Not run", length(x)))
  }
  .fmt_p(x)
}

.fmt_auc_ci <- function(est, lo, hi) {
  est <- as.numeric(est)
  lo <- as.numeric(lo)
  hi <- as.numeric(hi)
  n <- length(est)
  out <- rep(.em, n)
  full <- is.finite(est) & is.finite(lo) & is.finite(hi)
  out[full] <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f%s%.3f)", est[full], lo[full], .en, hi[full])
  point_only <- is.finite(est) & !full
  out[point_only] <- sprintf("%.3f", est[point_only])
  out
}

.translate_status <- function(st) {
  vapply(as.character(st), function(s) {
    if (is.na(s) || !nzchar(s)) return(.em)
    switch(
      s,
      ok = "Valid adjusted model (EPV >= 5, VIF < 5)",
      exploratory_low_epv_or_collinear = "Exploratory: low EPV (< 5) or elevated collinearity (5 <= VIF < 10)",
      failed_collinearity = "Aborted: severe multicollinearity with infiltration axis (VIF >= 10)",
      failed_separation_or_convergence = "Unreliable: quasi-complete separation or GLM non-convergence",
      s
    )
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

.translate_bg <- function(bg) {
  vapply(as.character(bg), function(b) {
    if (is.na(b) || !nzchar(b)) return(if (isTRUE(compute_null)) .em else "Not run")
    switch(
      b,
      subsampled_panel_cohort = "Subsampled panel cohort (~2,800 genes)",
      full_transcriptome = "Full transcriptome (>= 5,000 genes)",
      partial_ortholog_subset = "Partial ortholog-mapped subset (restricted background)",
      b
    )
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

.kable_wrap <- function(df, align = NULL, note_wrap = FALSE, ...) {
  if (is.null(align)) {
    align <- rep("l", ncol(df))
  }
  wrap_class <- if (isTRUE(note_wrap)) {
    "table-wrap allow-note-wrap"
  } else {
    "table-wrap"
  }
  k <- knitr::kable(
    df,
    format = "html",
    align = align,
    escape = TRUE,
    ...
  )
  cat(sprintf('<div class="%s">\n', wrap_class))
  cat(as.character(k), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n</div>\n")
  invisible(NULL)
}

.badge_class <- function(tier_label) {
  tl <- tolower(as.character(tier_label)[1])
  if (grepl("high", tl)) return("sb-badge sb-badge-high")
  if (grepl("medium", tl)) return("sb-badge sb-badge-med")
  "sb-badge sb-badge-low"
}
```

```{r tier1-kpi-cards, results='asis'}
best <- if (!is.null(model)) model$tier1$best_signature else NULL
if (!is.null(best) && nrow(best) > 0L) {
  auc_txt <- .fmt_auc_ci(best$auc_re[1], best$auc_re_ci_low[1], best$auc_re_ci_high[1])
  i2_txt <- if (is.finite(best$i2_logit[1])) sprintf("%.1f%%", best$i2_logit[1]) else .em
  badge_cls <- .badge_class(best$priority_tier[1])
  cat("<div class='sb-tier1-grid'>\n")
  cat(sprintf("<div class='sb-card'><p class='sb-card-label'>Best Independent Signature</p><p class='sb-card-value'>%s (%s, k=%d)</p></div>\n",
              best$signature[1], best$method[1], best$k[1]))
  cat(sprintf("<div class='sb-card'><p class='sb-card-label'>Pooled REML AUC (95%% CI)</p><p class='sb-card-value'>%s</p></div>\n", auc_txt))
  cat(sprintf("<div class='sb-card'><p class='sb-card-label'>Logit-Scale Heterogeneity (I2 logit)</p><p class='sb-card-value'>%s</p></div>\n", i2_txt))
  cat(sprintf("<div class='sb-card'><p class='sb-card-label'>Evidence Tier</p><p class='sb-card-value'><span class='%s'>%s</span></p></div>\n",
              badge_cls, best$priority_tier[1]))
  cat("</div>\n")
} else {
  cat("<div class='sb-notice'><strong>No evaluable independent signature.</strong> Check gene coverage or enable non-independent inclusion in summary settings.</div>\n")
}
```

```{r tier1-decision-cards, results='asis'}
  card_df <- data.frame(
```

```{r heatmap, fig.cap="AUC heatmap (low coverage shaded)"}
if (ok_hm) {
  print(SigBenchR::plot_auc_heatmap(results, method = hm, coverage_threshold = cov_thr))
```

```{r forest, fig.cap="AUC forest plot (DeLong 95% CI)"}
ok_fr <- is.data.frame(results) &&
  nrow(results) > 0L &&
  !is.na(fsig) &&
  nzchar(fsig) &&
  any(results$signature == fsig & results$method == hm & !(results$skipped %in% TRUE))
if (ok_fr) {
  forest_summary <- if (!is.null(model) && is.data.frame(model$tier2$summary_tbl)) {
    model$tier2$summary_tbl
  } else {
    tryCatch(
      suppressWarnings(
        SigBenchR::summarize_auc(results, method = hm, stratify_by = NULL)
      ),
      error = function(e) summary_tbl
    )
  }
  print(
    SigBenchR::plot_auc_forest(
      results,
      signature = fsig,
      method = hm,
      summary = forest_summary
    )
  )
} else {
  cat("No rows available for forest plot.\n")
}
```

## Biological Context (Reference Immune Axes)

```{r biological-context, results='asis'}
bio_tbl <- if (!is.null(model)) model$tier2$ref_axes else NULL
if (is.data.frame(bio_tbl) && nrow(bio_tbl) > 0L) {
  bio_show <- bio_tbl
  for (nm in names(bio_show)) {
    if (is.numeric(bio_show[[nm]])) {
      if (grepl("p(_|$)|pval|p_value", nm, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
        bio_show[[nm]] <- .fmt_p(bio_show[[nm]])
      } else {
        bio_show[[nm]] <- .fmt3(bio_show[[nm]])
      }
    } else if (is.logical(bio_show[[nm]])) {
      bio_show[[nm]] <- ifelse(is.na(bio_show[[nm]]), .em, ifelse(bio_show[[nm]], "YES", "no"))
    } else {
      bio_show[[nm]] <- ifelse(
        is.na(bio_show[[nm]]) | !nzchar(as.character(bio_show[[nm]])),
        .em,
        as.character(bio_show[[nm]])
      )
    }
  }
  .kable_wrap(bio_show, note_wrap = TRUE)
} else {
  cat("Biological context table unavailable (provide bio_context or datasets/signatures).\n")
}
```

```{r beyond-infiltration-section, results='asis'}
bi_obj <- if (!is.null(model) && !is.null(model$tier2$beyond_infiltration)) {
  model$tier2$beyond_infiltration
} else {
  beyond_inf
}
has_bi <- is.list(bi_obj) &&
  is.data.frame(bi_obj$per_cohort) &&
  nrow(bi_obj$per_cohort) > 0L

if (has_bi) {
  cat("\n\n## Beyond Infiltration (Adjusted Logistic Regression & Paired CV Delta-AUC)\n\n")
  cat(paste0(
    "<div class='sb-takeaway'><strong>Methodology & Diagnostic Guide:</strong> ",
    "Tests whether a signature adds independent predictive value beyond baseline T-cell infiltration ",
    "(<code>glm: response ~ sig_score_z + inf_score_z</code> vs <code>response ~ inf_score_z</code>). ",
    "Per-gene scaling (<code>zscore</code>/<code>rank</code>) and predictor standardization are learned strictly inside each training fold. ",
    "<strong>Raw LRT p</strong> (<code>lrt_p</code>) and <strong>BH-adjusted LRT FDR</strong> (<code>lrt_p_adj_bh</code>) are reported in separate columns; ",
    "independent value requires <code>lrt_p_adj_bh &lt; 0.05</code>, positive adjusted effect, and positive paired CV <code>delta_auc_combined</code>. ",
    "Cross-cohort synthesis uses sample-size weighted <strong>directional Stouffer Z</strong> (<code>combined_lrt_p</code>) so opposite-sign cohort effects ",
    "(<code>direction_conflict = YES</code>) cancel rather than inflating significance in the reference unsigned Fisher omnibus test (<code>fisher_omnibus_p</code>). ",
    "Cohorts with <strong>EPV &lt; 5</strong> or <strong>5 &le; VIF &lt; 10</strong> are exploratory; <strong>VIF &ge; 10</strong> aborts estimation as severe multicollinearity.</div>\n\n"
  ))

  sm_bi <- bi_obj$summary
  if (is.data.frame(sm_bi) && nrow(sm_bi) > 0L) {
    cat("### Cross-Cohort Directional Synthesis\n\n")
    sm_df <- data.frame(
      Signature = if ("signature" %in% names(sm_bi)) as.character(sm_bi$signature) else rep("Selected", nrow(sm_bi)),
      `Reference Axis` = as.character(sm_bi$infiltration_axis),
      Method = as.character(sm_bi$method),
      `Cohorts (k)` = as.integer(sm_bi$n_cohorts),
      `Independent (BH p < 0.05)` = as.integer(sm_bi$n_independent),
      `Directional Stouffer Z` = if ("stouffer_z" %in% names(sm_bi)) .fmt3(sm_bi$stouffer_z) else rep(.em, nrow(sm_bi)),
      `Directional Stouffer p` = .fmt_p(sm_bi$combined_lrt_p),
      `Direction Conflict` = if ("direction_conflict" %in% names(sm_bi)) ifelse(sm_bi$direction_conflict %in% TRUE, "YES (Opposite signs)", "no") else rep(.em, nrow(sm_bi)),
      `Fisher Omnibus p (Unsigned Ref)` = if ("fisher_omnibus_p" %in% names(sm_bi)) .fmt_p(sm_bi$fisher_omnibus_p) else rep(.em, nrow(sm_bi)),
      `Mean CV Delta-AUC` = .fmt3(sm_bi$mean_delta_auc),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    .kable_wrap(sm_df, note_wrap = TRUE)
  }

  pc_bi <- bi_obj$per_cohort
  cat("\n\n### Per-Cohort Adjusted Models & Collinearity / EPV Diagnostics\n\n")
  delta_range <- if (all(c("delta_min", "delta_max") %in% names(pc_bi))) {
    .fmt_auc_ci(pc_bi$delta_auc_combined, pc_bi$delta_min, pc_bi$delta_max)
  } else {
    .fmt_auc_ci(pc_bi$delta_auc_combined, pc_bi$delta_auc_ci_low, pc_bi$delta_auc_ci_high)
  }
  pc_df <- data.frame(
    Signature = if ("signature" %in% names(pc_bi)) as.character(pc_bi$signature) else rep("Selected", nrow(pc_bi)),
    Cohort = as.character(pc_bi$cohort),
    n = as.integer(pc_bi$n),
    EPV = if ("epv" %in% names(pc_bi)) sprintf("%.1f", pc_bi$epv) else rep(.em, nrow(pc_bi)),
    `Low EPV (<5)` = if ("low_epv" %in% names(pc_bi)) ifelse(pc_bi$low_epv %in% TRUE, "YES", "no") else rep(.em, nrow(pc_bi)),
    VIF = if ("vif" %in% names(pc_bi)) .fmt3(pc_bi$vif) else rep(.em, nrow(pc_bi)),
    `High VIF (>=5)` = if ("high_collinearity" %in% names(pc_bi)) ifelse(pc_bi$high_collinearity %in% TRUE, "YES", "no") else rep(.em, nrow(pc_bi)),
    `CV Delta-AUC (Repeat SD / Range (min-max))` = delta_range,
    `SD Delta-AUC` = if ("sd_delta_auc" %in% names(pc_bi)) .fmt3(pc_bi$sd_delta_auc) else rep(.em, nrow(pc_bi)),
    `Adjusted Beta` = .fmt3(pc_bi$beta_adjusted),
    `Raw LRT p` = .fmt_p(pc_bi$lrt_p),
    `BH-Adjusted LRT FDR` = if ("lrt_p_adj_bh" %in% names(pc_bi)) .fmt_p(pc_bi$lrt_p_adj_bh) else rep(.em, nrow(pc_bi)),
    `Independent Value` = ifelse(pc_bi$adds_independent_value %in% TRUE, "YES", "no"),
    `Diagnostic Status` = if ("analysis_status" %in% names(pc_bi)) .translate_status(pc_bi$analysis_status) else rep(.em, nrow(pc_bi)),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  .kable_wrap(pc_df, note_wrap = TRUE)
}
```

```{r clinical-benefit, results='asis'}
surv_tbl <- if (!is.null(model) && !is.null(model$tier2$survival)) model$tier2$survival else surv_res
has_surv <- !is.null(surv_tbl) && is.data.frame(surv_tbl) && nrow(surv_tbl) > 0L
if (has_surv) {
  cat("\n\n## Clinical Benefit (Survival Benchmark)\n\n")
  cat(paste0(
    "<div class='sb-takeaway'><strong>Hypothesis Families & PH Diagnostic Note:</strong> ",
    "Continuous Cox proportional hazards regression (<code>Raw Cox p</code> vs <code>Cox BH-Adjusted FDR</code>) and ",
    "median-dichotomized Kaplan-Meier log-rank tests (<code>Raw Log-Rank p</code> vs <code>Log-Rank BH-Adjusted FDR</code>) ",
    "test distinct statistical hypotheses and are BH-adjusted as separate families. ",
    "The Schoenfeld residual proportional hazards test (<code>PH Diagnostic p (Unadjusted)</code>, <code>ph_p</code>) ",
    "is a model assumption check rather than an efficacy p-value; it is intentionally left unadjusted so PH violations (<code>ph_p &lt; 0.05</code>) are never masked by FDR correction.</div>\n\n"
  ))
  hr_ci <- .fmt_auc_ci(surv_tbl$hr, surv_tbl$hr_ci_low, surv_tbl$hr_ci_high)
  surv_df <- data.frame(
    Cohort = as.character(surv_tbl$cohort),
    Signature = if ("signature" %in% names(surv_tbl)) as.character(surv_tbl$signature) else rep(.em, nrow(surv_tbl)),
    Method = if ("method" %in% names(surv_tbl)) as.character(surv_tbl$method) else rep(hm, nrow(surv_tbl)),
    Endpoint = as.character(surv_tbl$endpoint),
    `n (Events)` = sprintf("%d (%d)", as.integer(surv_tbl$n_samples), as.integer(surv_tbl$n_events)),
    `HR (95% CI)` = hr_ci,
    `C-Index` = .fmt3(surv_tbl$c_index),
    `Raw Cox p` = .fmt_p(surv_tbl$cox_p),
    `Cox BH-Adjusted FDR` = if ("p_adj_bh" %in% names(surv_tbl)) .fmt_p(surv_tbl$p_adj_bh) else rep(.em, nrow(surv_tbl)),
    `Raw Log-Rank p` = .fmt_p(surv_tbl$logrank_p),
    `Log-Rank BH-Adjusted FDR` = if ("logrank_p_adj_bh" %in% names(surv_tbl)) .fmt_p(surv_tbl$logrank_p_adj_bh) else rep(.em, nrow(surv_tbl)),
    `PH Diagnostic p (Unadjusted)` = .fmt_p(surv_tbl$ph_p),
    `PH Violated` = ifelse(surv_tbl$ph_violated %in% TRUE, "YES (PH violated)", "no"),
    Note = ifelse(is.na(surv_tbl$surv_note) | !nzchar(as.character(surv_tbl$surv_note)), .em, as.character(surv_tbl$surv_note)),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  .kable_wrap(surv_df, note_wrap = TRUE)
}
```

# Tier 3: Technical Appendix {.sb-tier-break}

<details class="sb-appendix" open>
<summary>Cohort-Level Performance, PR-AUC Stability, Null Permutation FDR & Coverage Diagnostics</summary>

```{r performance-table, results='asis'}
perf <- if (!is.null(model) && is.data.frame(model$tier3$cohort_metrics)) model$tier3$cohort_metrics else results
if (is.data.frame(perf) && nrow(perf) > 0L) {
  cat(paste0(
    "<div class='sb-takeaway'><strong>Column Glossary:</strong> ",
    "<ul>",
    "<li><strong>ROC-AUC (95% CI):</strong> DeLong point estimate and 95% confidence interval.</li>",
    "<li><strong>PR-AUC (95% CI) &amp; Stability Diagnostics:</strong> Precision-Recall AUC with stratified bootstrap 95% CI, prevalence baseline (<code>n_pos / n</code>), <code>Tie Fraction</code>, <code>Small Positive Class</code> (<code>n_pos &lt; 5</code> or <code>n_neg &lt; 5</code>), valid bootstrap replicates (<code>n_boot_valid</code>), and <code>PR CI Unreliable</code> flag.</li>",
    "<li><strong>Null Permutation Hypothesis Families:</strong> <code>Raw Null p</code> (empirical random-gene p-value), <code>BH FDR</code> (showing within-method <code>null_p_adj_bh</code> / global <code>null_p_adj_bh_global</code>), and <code>Flags</code> summarizing coverage status, small cohort / small positive class, PR CI instability, and <code>Null Background Universe</code> (full transcriptome vs. subsampled panel cohort).</li>",
    "</ul></div>\n\n"
  ))
  auc_ci <- if (all(c("auc", "auc_ci_low", "auc_ci_high") %in% names(perf))) {
    .fmt_auc_ci(perf$auc, perf$auc_ci_low, perf$auc_ci_high)
  } else {
    .fmt3(perf$auc)
  }
  pr_ci <- if (all(c("pr_auc", "pr_ci_low", "pr_ci_high") %in% names(perf))) {
    .fmt_auc_ci(perf$pr_auc, perf$pr_ci_low, perf$pr_ci_high)
  } else if ("pr_auc" %in% names(perf)) {
    .fmt3(perf$pr_auc)
  } else {
    rep(.em, nrow(perf))
  }
  status <- if ("coverage_status" %in% names(perf)) as.character(perf$coverage_status) else rep(.em, nrow(perf))
  bh_col <- if ("null_p_adj_bh" %in% names(perf)) {
    .fmt_null(perf$null_p_adj_bh)
  } else if ("null_p_adj_bh_global" %in% names(perf)) {
    .fmt_null(perf$null_p_adj_bh_global)
  } else {
    rep(if (isTRUE(compute_null)) .em else "Not run", nrow(perf))
  }
  flags_vec <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(perf)), function(i) {
    fl <- character(0)
    if (!is.na(status[i]) && nzchar(status[i]) && !status[i] %in% c("OK", .em)) {
      fl <- c(fl, status[i])
    }
    if ("small_cohort" %in% names(perf) && isTRUE(perf$small_cohort[i])) {
      fl <- c(fl, "small_cohort")
    }
    if ("small_positive_class" %in% names(perf) && isTRUE(perf$small_positive_class[i])) {
      fl <- c(fl, "small_pos_class(<5)")
    }
    if ("ci_unreliable" %in% names(perf) && isTRUE(perf$ci_unreliable[i])) {
      fl <- c(fl, "PR_CI_unreliable")
    }
    if ("background_type" %in% names(perf) && !is.na(perf$background_type[i]) &&
        nzchar(as.character(perf$background_type[i]))) {
      fl <- c(fl, .translate_bg(perf$background_type[i]))
    }
    if (length(fl) == 0L) "OK" else paste(fl, collapse = "; ")
  }, character(1))
  out <- data.frame(
    Signature = as.character(perf$signature),
    Cohort = as.character(perf$dataset),
    Method = as.character(perf$method),
    `n (Pos/Neg)` = ifelse(
      is.finite(perf$n) & is.finite(perf$n_pos) & is.finite(perf$n_neg),
      sprintf("%d (%d/%d)", as.integer(perf$n), as.integer(perf$n_pos), as.integer(perf$n_neg)),
      .em
    ),
    `ROC-AUC (95% CI)` = auc_ci,
    `PR-AUC (95% CI)` = pr_ci,
    Coverage = if ("coverage_pct" %in% names(perf)) .fmt_pct(perf$coverage_pct) else rep(.em, nrow(perf)),
    `Raw Null p` = if ("null_p" %in% names(perf)) .fmt_null(perf$null_p) else rep(if (isTRUE(compute_null)) .em else "Not run", nrow(perf)),
    `BH FDR` = bh_col,
    Flags = flags_vec,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  .kable_wrap(out, note_wrap = TRUE)
}
```

```{r params-table, results='asis'}
  paste0("Run (n_perm = ", as.character(pick(pl$n_perm, NA)), ")")
} else {

if (is.null(man) && is.data.frame(results)) {
  man <- SigBenchR::build_reproducibility_manifest(
    results = results,
    summary_tbl = if (is.data.frame(summary_tbl) && nrow(summary_tbl) > 0L) summary_tbl else NULL,
    report_model = model,
    params_list = pl
  )

  Parameter = c(

  ),
  Value = c(
    paste(pick(pl$methods, character(0)), collapse = ", "),
    as.character(pick(pl$direction, "<")),
    as.character(pick(pl$sd_handling, "exclude")),
    as.character(pick(pl$coverage_threshold, NA)),
    as.character(pick(pl$sensitivity_threshold, NA)),
    as.character(pick(pl$n_boot, NA)),
    null_status,
    as.character(pick(pl$seed, NA)),
    as.character(pick(pl$match_expression, FALSE)),
    hm,
    as.character(fsig),
    as.character(pick(rmeta$version, .em)),
    as.character(pick(rmeta$md5, .em)),
    as.character(pick(if (!is.null(man)) man$reproducibility_hash else NULL, .em)),
    as.character(pick(if (!is.null(man)) man$timestamp_utc else NULL, .em))
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
.kable_wrap(param_df, align = c("l", "l"))
```
